newsitem.title: FRANCE: Malev set to name new French cargo gsa.
newsitem.headline: Malev set to name new French cargo gsa.

text.p: Hungarian state airline, Malev, said it would be announcing the appointment of a cargo sales agent France in the next few days.

"Air France currently serves as our gsa for cargo but this agreement expires at the end of the month and will not be renewed. The appointment of a new gsa will take effect from the beginning of April," a Paris-based Malev official told Reuters
Malev currently operates ten passenger flights weekly between Paris/CDG and Budapest and also 13 flights weekly code-shared with Air France.
Malev operates Boeing 737 series aircraft and Air France Airbus 320s. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
